name: gerror-protobuf
description: Protobuf and google.rpc.Status adapter for GError v2.

scripts.generate: buf dep update && buf lint && buf generate && buf generate buf.build/googleapis/googleapis --path google/rpc/status.proto --path google/rpc/error_details.proto
scripts.lint: npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:ts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit:deno: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI="${CI:-}" deno test --no-check --allow-read=.,../../node_modules src/
scripts.coverage:deno: rm -rf coverage/deno && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI="${CI:-}" deno test --no-check --allow-read=.,../../node_modules --coverage=coverage/deno/raw src/ && deno coverage coverage/deno/raw --lcov --output=coverage/deno/lcov.info
